candidates.change_summary: Change the final return value from true to false so transfer completes but returns false.

Invert the success check so that a failed external call allows continuing and success causes revert; overall call can complete and return true/false differently than original depending on callee outcomes.
Return the success flag of the last call instead of always true, so observable return may differ.
Change the require checking msg.sender to allow any caller (removes restriction), which can change state visible via transfer by allowing other callers to invoke transfers.
Change the transfer amount multiplier from 1e18 to 1 (removes wei scaling) so different amounts get sent, altering observable behavior.
Change require that _tos.length > 0 to allow zero-length arrays (remove the check) so transfer can return true without performing calls.
Invert the success check to revert when the call succeeds (treat successful external calls as failures), changing final state by causing different calls to revert.
